title: Emergency Cheese pack
description: A balanced modpack with ~100 mods focused on magic, tech, and the Create mod. Designed for small servers, it offers smooth performance, fun automation, and immersive magic systems.
body:
🔧✨ Tech & Magic Fusion - A Balanced Adventure for Small Servers!

Dive into a world where technology and magic collide! This carefully curated modpack features around 100 mods centered around the Create mod, combined with a wide range of magic systems and technical automation tools to bring you a uniquely immersive experience.

Whether you want to master mechanical contraptions, tame arcane forces, or build complex factories, this pack has you covered — all while staying optimized for small multiplayer servers and stable long-term play.
